EMAIL_BRANDING.TITLE: Email branding
EMAIL_BRANDING.NOTE: How this account's emails and CSAT survey page look. Anything left empty uses the installation's own branding. This applies to what your customers see — the dashboard, the favicon and the widget keep the installation's brand.

NAME.LABEL: Brand name
NAME.HELP: Shown in the email footer, after "Powered by".

COLOR.LABEL: Brand color
COLOR.HELP: Used for the accent bar and links. A colour too light to read on white is darkened for text, keeping its hue.

LOGO.LABEL: Email logo
LOGO.HELP: PNG, JPG or GIF, up to 2 MB. SVG is not accepted because email clients do not render it.
